text:
The runaway-search proposal is clear, and I logged one "clear" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`. `Server/text-check.mjs` flagged nothing.

The title states the point and the numbered deliverables are easy to scan. Deliverables 1 and 2 run long, but I left them because this is a spec for agents, not a page for the owner.

Review written to `runaway-search/review.md` — **verdict: fix**.

- **Code itself checks out**: both deliverables match the brief closely, I independently reran `Servex/processes.test.mjs` (108 checks) and `.claude/hooks/server-guard.test.mjs` (60/60) on the worktree and confirmed `node --check` is clean — all matching what the minion reported.
- **The one real gap**: commits `149fe5e63` and `a91f41936` are still only on `worktree/runaway-search` — not merged into any dev branch — so Servex and any main-checkout shell are still running the old code. The fix the task exists to ship (stopping a burning orphan search) isn't actually protecting anything yet.
- **One minor note**: `server-guard.mjs`'s new flag-detector can mistake a quoted literal pattern like `"-r"` for the `-r` flag and over-block a harmless `grep` — fails safe, not a real risk, just worth a look.
